import Foundation

protocol Shape { var area: Double { get } }
struct Circle: Shape { let r: Double; var area: Double { .pi * r * r } }
enum Dir: String, CaseIterable { case north, east, south, west }

final class Robot {
    private(set) var pos: (x: Int, y: Int) = (0, 0)
    var dir: Dir = .north
    init(dir: Dir = .north) { self.dir = dir }
    func move(_ cmds: String) throws -> Self {
        for c in cmds {
            switch c {
            case "A": pos.y += 1
            case "L", "R": dir = Dir.allCases[(Dir.allCases.firstIndex(of: dir)! + 1) % 4]
            default: throw NSError(domain: "bad", code: 1)
            }
        }
        return self
    }
}

@discardableResult
func apply<T>(_ x: T, _ f: (T) -> T) -> T { f(x) }
let s = Circle(r: 1).area
let r = try? Robot().move("ALR")
if let r, s > 0 { print(r.pos, "\(s)") }
